newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar nudges higher but ranges tight.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar nudges higher but ranges tight.

text.p: White sugar futures perked up in modest volume on Monday after the reopen of the New York raws market as trade buying propped the spot March contract. But March, which dominated the overall volume in mainly outright dealings, was pinioned in a tight range of $1.70.

Light commission house selling was seen earlier to cap some of the gains but by 1635 GMT March had nudged back to stand $1.30 higher at an intraday $305.20 and traded 1,008 lots. "There's decent volume considering the range," a trader said. The second-month May contract was up $1.00 at $305.00 with overall volume at 1,202 lots.
Earlier, commission house dealings in March had accounted for the bulk of the March volume, mainly in crossed trades.
Paris trading was very thin at a total 187 lots. March was up $1.00 at $305.00 and May up 80 cents at $304.80.
